name: Groupe Bruxelles Lambert SA
summary: Groupe Bruxelles Lambert SA invests in a portfolio of industrial and services companies operating in various sectors. The company operates through four segments: Holding, Imerys, Sapiens/Webhelp, and Sienna Capital. It operates in Belgium, other European countries, North America, and internationally. The company was incorporated in 1902 and is based in Brussels, Belgium.
